ablation.name: d7_deep_backbone_15ep
ablation.notes: D7: Backbone capacity expansion. num_res_blocks 4→6 (+50% cross-attention layers). Theory: ALL loss-level (D1/D2/D6) and velocity-head (D4) modifications failed. DINO-sty ceiling at 0.476 is a CAPACITY limit, not a loss problem. 6 layers of cross-attention = 50% more style injection points = higher style representation capacity. Pure structural scaling — no new loss terms, no velocity head modification, no external models. VRAM budget: current 9.08GB + ~1.5GB for 2 extra layers = ~10.6GB (within 11.2GB). bs=96 for VRAM safety. Goal: DINO-sty >= 0.49, CLIP-S >= 0.715.
